title: What the Flock?
author: Nicholas Rockstroh
problems: Row 4 "slide left along set" can't start from where the dancers are: Couple 1 must stand side by side in a line facing across.
The progression after row 8 "larks allemande right ¾ to next larks" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 10 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 11 "balance the ring" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 12 "larks take partners, partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 1 "mad robins, larks in front" can't start from where the dancers are: A mad robin needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.
Row 2 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 3 "larks roll away neighbors with a half sashay" can't start from where the dancers are: A roll away needs the two side by side on one side.
Row 5 "robins allemande right once" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 5 and 7 are too far apart to turn by the hand.

figures.text: larks roll away neighbors with a half sashay
form an ocean wave & balance - robins by right hands and neighbors by left hands
